headlines.description: Deshaun Watson ran 49 yards for a touchdown in his first NFL start and led the Houston Texans' depleted offense to a late clinching field goal in a 13-9 victory over the Cincinnati Bengals on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Watson runs for TD, leads Texans over Bengals 13-9 in debut

headlines.description: Carson Palmer's late rally got the Arizona Cardinals into overtime Sunday and Tyrann Mathieu's interception set up Phil Dawson for a 30-yard field goal to help them leave Indianapolis with a 16-13 win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Palmer rallies Cardinals to steal 16-13 OT win at Indy

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Chiefs rookie Kareem Hunt reached the end zone twice, Travis Kelce took a shovel pass 15 yards for the go-ahead touchdown and Kansas City held on to beat the Philadelphia Eagles 27-20 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hunt scores 2 TDs as Chiefs hold on to beat Eagles 27-20

events.name: New England Patriots at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: If Tom Brady and the Patriots were suffering from a Super Bowl hangover, it looks as though a trip to New Orleans pulled the defending champions out of it.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady torches Saints in 36-20 Patriots victory

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger threw a pair of first-half touchdown passes, Le'Veon Bell ran for 87 yards and the Pittsburgh Steelers kept the Minnesota Vikings in check during a 26-9 victory on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers shut down Bradford-less Vikings in 26-9 victory

events.name: Chicago Bears at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Jameis Winston threw for 204 yards and one touchdown Sunday, helping the Tampa Bay Buccaneers return from an unscheduled bye week forced by Hurricane Irma to open the season with a 29-7 rout of the mistake-prone Chicago Bears.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston, Buccaneers' defense shine in 29-7 rout of Bears

headlines.description: Carolina's defense allowed only three points for the second straight week, and Graham Gano converted three field goals as the Panthers held on to defeat the Buffalo Bills 9-3 on Sunday.
Derrick Henry, Delanie Walker and Jalston Fowler each ran for touchdowns, and the Tennessee Titans dominated the Jacksonville Jaguars in the second half for a 37-16 victory.
The Ravens are making a habit of converting turnovers into victories.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens force 5 turnovers in 24-10 win over Browns

events.name: New York Jets at Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: Marshawn Lynch ran for a touchdown in his first home game with Oakland and Derek Carr threw three TD passes to Michael Crabtree to lead the Raiders to a 45-20 victory over the New York Jets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marshawn Lynch runs for TD in Raiders' 45-20 win over Jets

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: Cody Parkey hit his fourth field goal from 54 yards with 1:05 to play, and the Miami Dolphins rallied in the fourth quarter to spoil the Los Angeles Chargers' home opener with a 19-17 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins hold on to spoil Chargers' LA debut, 19-17

headlines.description: Trevor Siemian tied a career high with four touchdown passes and the Denver Broncos held Ezekiel Elliott to the worst game of his career -- 8 yards on nine carries -- in a 42-17 blowout of the Dallas Cowboys on Sunday.

events.name: Washington Redskins at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw an 11-yard touchdown pass to Ryan Grant with 1:49 to play to give the Washington Redskins a 27-20 victory Sunday against the Los Angeles Rams and rookie head coach Sean McVay.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins, Thompson lead Redskins to 27-20 win vs. Rams

headlines.description: Russell Wilson avoided two potential sacks and found Paul Richardson in the front corner of the end zone for a 9-yard touchdown with 7:06 left and the Seattle Seahawks held on for an unsightly 12-9 win over the San Francisco 49ers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson's escape act helps Seahawks top 49ers 12-9

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Matt Ryan and the Atlanta Falcons picked up where they left off against the Green Bay Packers, building a big halftime lead on the way to a dominating victory Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons with a repeat performance in 34-23 win over Packers

events.name: Detroit Lions at New York Giants

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford threw for two touchdowns, rookie Jamal Agnew broke the game open with an 88-yard punt return in the fourth quarter and the Detroit Lions beat the New York Giants 24-10 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford throws 2 TDs as Lions beat Giants and Beckham
